name: Indian summer
story: A gift of a day: warm, still air under a big autumn high, a deep thermal layer under a lid at 1600 m, neat cumulus over the hills and the birches gold below them. The radio is already talking about the equinox gale.
forecast: Warm and fair, 18-19 C. Cumulus from 11:00, base 1500 m, tops near 1600 m. Southwest 5 kt. Thermal turbulence in the afternoon. A GALE is forecast for the day after tomorrow.
